name: Harmonies
description: A serene puzzle game where players create landscapes by placing colorful tokens to form patterns and attract animals to their ecosystem. The satisfying spatial puzzle combines accessibility with surprising depth.
thoughts: This is my favorite new game of 2025.  My wife and I found in a cafe in Hamilton and immedately bought a copy to be played, and have played and taught it numerous times.  Quick to learn, but good depth

name: Frosthaven
description: A massive tactical combat adventure and sequel to Gloomhaven, featuring a new cast of characters defending a northern outpost against harsh wilderness threats. The campaign offers hundreds of hours of strategic dungeon-crawling gameplay.
thoughts: It's hard not to keep this in the list as we keep playing a campaign that's now a year old.  It's not for everyone and you'll want the X-Haven app to help with EVERYTHING

name: Civolution
description: Civolution is a complex, heavy Euro-style strategy game by Stefan Feld in which players act as deities using a unique dice-selection mechanic to guide a civilization's technological and cultural evolution over four eras.
thoughts: It is not quick to teach and it is not a quick game to play but man it's good.  The action selection mechanic is very unique and almost needed when there are 22 different actions to take.

name: Flip 7
description: A fast paced, press your luck game of drawing just one more card to earn more points with the risk of busting out.
thoughts: My wife and I got this for my brother and his family for Christmas, immedately played 4 games, and my sister-in-law instrgramed it.  It must be good.

name: Draftasaurus
description: Draftusaurus is a light, fast-paced family game where players draft dinosaur meeples from hand to hand and strategically place them into their personal zoo parks to score points based on specific pen requirements.
thoughts: We finally brought the real version.  I still think it's better on BoardGameArena, but it plays much better than expected live. A great little filler!
